english_query: what is the multi state cooperative societies act
english_answer:
The Multi-State Co-operative Societies Act, 1984 is a law that governs the formation,
management, and operation of multi-state co-operative societies in India. It was passed by the
Parliament of India in 1984 and came into effect on 19th August, 2002. The Act aims to
promote the growth of multi-state co-operative societies by providing a framework for their
registration, operation, and management. It also aims to protect the interests of members of
these societies and to promote the growth of the co-operative movement in India.
